level.title: The Drowned Abbey of Saint Vael
level.intro: The abbey sank in a single night, bells still ringing. The water has gone down since. Something in the crypt has not.

lychgate.title: Collapsed Lychgate
lychgate.prose: A roofed gate half-buried in mud marks the edge of the abbey grounds. Lanterns, a trader's cart and a stash chest make a camp of it. This is the only way out.

narthex.title: Flooded Narthex
narthex.prose: Black water stands waist-deep under a cracked vault. Coins glint and vanish in the silt where other delvers lost their footing.

ossuary.title: Ossuary Hall
ossuary.prose: Bones are stacked to the ceiling in neat, terrible rows. Some of them are standing up.

chapel.title: Chapel of Drowned Saints
chapel.prose: Saints carved in green stone weep real water onto an altar crusted with offerings.

scriptorium.title: Scriptorium
scriptorium.prose: Copy desks rot in rows. An iron-bound chest squats beneath a lectern that still holds a swollen tome.

cloister.title: Collapsed Cloister
cloister.prose: The garth is a field of fallen columns. Something with too many teeth nests in the rubble that chokes the east walk.

bell_stair.title: Bell Tower Stair
bell_stair.prose: The stair spirals up into darkness. Far above, a bronze bell hangs on a single rotten beam.

reliquary.title: Reliquary
reliquary.prose: Empty niches line the walls. One gilded coffer remains, untouched, in the middle of the floor.

kitchens.title: Kitchens & Cellar
kitchens.prose: Three goblins have made a home of the abbey ovens. They watch you over a pot of something that was recently alive.

cistern_bridge.title: Cistern Bridge
cistern_bridge.prose: A slick stone span crosses a cistern that drops into roaring dark. Iron rings for a guide rope are set in both ends.

sacristy.title: Hidden Sacristy
sacristy.prose: A dry room, sealed for a century. Vestments hang untouched beside a strongbox and a signet on a velvet cushion.

drowned_choir.title: The Drowned Choir
drowned_choir.prose: The choir stalls are full. The singers are grey, bloated, and hungry.

sepulchre.title: Abbot's Sepulchre
sepulchre.prose: The Drowned Abbot rises from a flooded tomb, crozier dripping, and begins the evening office in a voice like a tide.

actions.narthex.wade_out: Wade carefully back to the Lychgate
actions.chapel.desecrate: Pry the offerings from the altar
actions.cloister.clear_rubble: Clear the rubble on the east walk
actions.bell.spot: Look for traps on the stair
actions.kitchens.buy_potion: Buy a potion from the goblins (20g)
actions.bridge.tie_rope: Tie your rope across the bridge

outcomes.gold_lost_in_silt: Your foot slips; coins spill into the silt.
outcomes.only_mud: Only mud and a drowned rat.
outcomes.bones_clatter: A loose skull rolls and clatters. Empty sockets turn toward you.
outcomes.the_saints_weep: The saints' tears run red. Something in the font stirs and climbs out.
outcomes.noise_carries: The racket echoes down the halls. Something answers.
outcomes.pages_crumble: The pages crumble before you make sense of them.
outcomes.rubble_shifts: The rubble shifts but won't clear.
outcomes.nothing_seen: The stair looks like a stair.
outcomes.bell_tolls: With a crack the bell drops and tolls. Far below, the choir falls silent and listens.
outcomes.coffer_breathes: The coffer's lid rises and falls. It is breathing.
outcomes.just_a_coffer: It seems to be just a coffer.
outcomes.coffer_bites: The lid opens into a mouth.
outcomes.chalk_mark: A seam in the stone gives under your hand. You chalk an X for whoever comes next.
outcomes.goblins_deal: The goblins lower their knives. They have a potion to sell, and a warning: the bridge is slick on the left.
outcomes.goblins_scatter: The goblins scatter, dropping a purse in their hurry.
outcomes.swept_away: The current takes you over the edge and spits you out in the Narthex.
outcomes.abbot_hesitates: The Abbot sees the signet and falters. For a moment, he remembers.
outcomes.abbot_scorns: The Abbot laughs, a sound like water in a drain.
outcomes.abbot_falls: The Abbot sinks back into the water, and does not rise. Below, the stairs to the deeper crypt drain.
